Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in IT shall be 05 (Five) years.
2. The Supplier must submit NOA and Completion Certificate of honoring 2 tender each of minimum Taka 15 (Fifteen) Lac on of
Supplying IT and related equipment in the last two (02) years in the government/semi government organization with e-GP Tender
ID.
3. The required average annual turnover shall be greater than Tk 40 Lacs (fifty lacs) over the last 03 (Three) years.
4. The Minimum amount of liquid assets i.e. working capital or credit line (s) of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 19 Lacs (Nineteen lacs).
5. The Supplier must submit Up-to-date Trade License, Valid TIN Certificate, VAT Registration/ BIN certificate, with return certificate
of the financial year 2024-25.
6. Authentic Authorization Letter/ Distributor Certificate from OEM (Local Manufacturer will not be accepted).
7. Valid documents having office / Sub office in Chittagong for instant support and service.
8. Tender Document containing insufficient / incomplete information will be rejected.
9. Furnishing of any false, fake & forged document or information by a tender shall result in rejection of his tender and may lead to
forfeiture of Tender Security and action against tender under regular of PPR 2025
